data.title: Marwadi University Project Help
data.description: Working on a Marwadi University project? Whether you're building a React application, a MERN Stack project, a Python system, or an AI-based solution, I can help you plan, build, debug, deploy, and understand your project.

data.text: Every project should be original, easy to explain during your viva, and completed before your submission deadline.

data.title: Who Is This Service For?
data.description: This service is designed for Marwadi University students who need technical guidance or development assistance with academic software projects.

data.title: Technologies We Support
data.description: Choose the stack that fits your project requirements.

data.title: Need Help With an Existing Project?
data.description: Already started your Marwadi University project? I can help fix issues instead of rebuilding everything.

data.text: Student-friendly pricing with transparent estimates based on your project's requirements.

data.title: Free Consultation Before You Decide
data.description: We'll discuss your project idea, college requirements, deadline, and budget before any development starts.

data.question: Can you help if my project is already half completed?
data.answer: Yes. I can review your existing work, identify problems, and help complete or improve it.

data.question: Do you provide documentation and deployment support?
data.answer: Yes. Documentation, deployment guidance, and project explanation can be included based on your requirements.
